newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Village says radio profits rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Village says radio profits rise.

text.p: Leisure group Village Roadshow Ltd said on Wednesday that its 25 percent rise in 1995/96 net profit to A$47.49 million was based on a strong recovery by its radio network operations.

The company, which is also involved in movie exhibition and distribution and theme parks, said the 20.5 percent rise in sales to A$297.12 million was mainly due to increased revenue from the FM radio operations of its listed Austereo Ltd unit and the three theme parks based on Queensland's Gold Coast.
It did not issue a forecast for the current year.
The cinema, film and leisure division recorded the smallest rise in net profit but remained the single largest division, with earnings up to A$22.88 million from A$21.76 million a year ago.
The theme parks division increased net profit to A$10.57 million from A$7.85 million while the radio division increased net profit to A$14.04 million from A$8.38 million.
Village Roadshow's tax bill also fell to A$6.61 million from A$10.39 million.
